run_metadata.coverage_summary: WebSearch-only discovery run (external WebFetch remained blocked by the environment egress proxy, as on prior days). Tier 1 Commonwealth (AusTender) and all eight state/territory portals were probed via search snippets; concrete recently-published/open opportunities were captured for NSW eTendering/buy.nsw, AusTender (Commonwealth incl. CSIRO and Defence), plus Tier 2 government-owned water corporations (Sydney Water, Melbourne Water). Tier 3 was attempted per mandate (SAP Ariba Discovery, Rio Tinto Buy Local, BHP, Telstra/Optus/NBN, airports/ports, EstimateOne): corporate opportunity detail is login/registration-gated and none was publicly visible, so corporate portals are recorded in discovered_sources only, not fabricated as tenders. One genuinely new buyer-originated source found: BuyICT (Commonwealth Digital Marketplace, buyict.gov.au).
gaps: NETWORK EGRESS BLOCK (primary cause of degraded run, same as recent prior runs): every WebFetch call to an external host was denied by the environment egress proxy (EGRESS_BLOCKED), confirmed against en.wikipedia.org as well as every tender portal (tenders.gov.au, tenders.nsw.gov.au, tenders.vic.gov.au, vendorpanel.com.au, bhp.com). This is an organisation egress policy and was not retried or routed around per proxy guidance. Only WebSearch (US-based, via Anthropic) and the GitHub MCP were reachable.

Because no external detail page or specification document could be opened, deliverables/requirements/evaluation-criteria/value/contacts could not be extracted for ANY entry; all 10 tenders are headline-level and pending a detail pass. Fields not present in search snippets are left null/"" rather than inferred.

Tier 1: AusTender and all state/territory portals could only be read through WebSearch snippets, not their live ATM/RFT lists or feeds, so full lists and pagination could not be swept. Tenders WA, Tenders SA, ACT Tenders and NT QTOL returned only portal landing pages in search (no specific current opportunities surfaced this run).

The 'Tenders SA' query initially collided with 'South Africa' results (SARS/eTenders ZA); those were discarded and a corrected query run — no specific SA (South Australia) opportunity surfaced beyond the portal itself.

Tier 3 SAP Ariba Discovery / SAP Business Network Discovery: no specific currently-open, publicly-visible Australian RFx could be confirmed via search (results were generic platform/how-to pages). Corporate opportunities on Ariba/Coupa/Rio Tinto Buy Local are registration- or invitation-gated; recorded as portals in discovered_sources, not as tenders. Invitation-only management-consultancy RFPs remain out of scope and were not fabricated.

Sydney Water (biochar EOI) and Melbourne Water (Cardinia Dam Upgrade EOI) and the Tasmanian council bitumen-surfacing item are captured from search-snippet descriptions only; their tender IDs, closing dates and documents were not verifiable without portal access and need confirmation on a future authenticated/unblocked run.
recommended_seed_additions: https://www.buyict.gov.au — BuyICT (Commonwealth Digital Marketplace / ICT & digital sourcing platform, run by the Digital Transformation Agency); buyer-originated Commonwealth e-procurement channel not previously in the known-source list.
